title: ContextLedger
description: Bounded, scored, tiered cache for agent working context. Hot tier <= budget; cold tier persisted; high-salience kinds preserved verbatim to prevent rot.

clock.description: Logical clock (tick per ingest). Deterministic — NOT wall-clock.

weights.description: Scoring weights tuned by the optimization loop (LSC-5).

id.description: sha1(kind+normalized content)[:16] — stable identity for dedupe/upsert.

kind.description: decision/constraint/lesson/open_question/task_state/file_ref are LOSSLESS-preserved on compaction. `lesson` is a model-distilled generalizable guideline (from feedback/critique); all other lossless kinds are deterministic captures.

provenance.description: untrusted = tool output / web / files / other agents. Rendered inside <data> blocks (two-channel boundary, LSC-7).

pinned.description: Never evicted; score = +inf. Use for invariants that must never rot.
